self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: After using skill: +80 EM for 12s (R1) Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

After Lunarbloom hit: +24% crit DMG for 12s (R1) Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

If both previous conditions are active, add the 1.5x bonus delta (R1) Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: An angular box carved from gold and jade. Legend has it that it was once enshrined in a temple deep within Tulaytullah, the Sapphire City.

refinements.1: CRIT Rate is increased by <r>8%</r>. When the equipping character unleashes an Elemental Skill, they gain the Secret of Lies effect: Elemental Mastery is increased by <r>80</r> for 12s. When the equipping character deals Lunar-Bloom DMG to an opponent, they gain the Moon of Truth effect: CRIT DMG is increased by <r>24%</r> for 4s. When both the Secret of Lies and Moon of Truth effects are active at the same time, the results of both effects will be increased by 50%.

fr.flavor: Un coffret anguleux sculpté en or et en jade. La légende raconte qu'il était autrefois conservé dans un temple au cœur de Tulaytullah, la cité de saphir.

refinements.1: Le taux CRIT augmente de <r>8 %</r>. Lorsqu'il déclenche une compétence élémentaire, le personnage équipé de l'arme obtient l'effet Secret du mensonge : augmente la maîtrise élémentaire de <r>80</r> pts pendant 12 s. Lorsque le personnage équipé de l'arme inflige des DGT de réaction de Sélénofleurissement à un ennemi, il obtient l'effet Lune de la vérité : augmente les DGT CRIT de <r>24 %</r> pendant 4 s. Si ces deux effets existent en même temps, leurs bonus augmentent de 50 %.
